basics.name: Stefan Stepanovic
basics.label: Computer Vision Research Engineer
basics.summary: Research engineer in computer vision with several years of experience in industrial R&D, working on structure from motion, neural rendering, and 3D generative modeling. Focused on connecting classical geometric vision and deep learning approaches to advance 3D scene understanding and its applications.

work.name: YDrive AI
work.position: Senior Research Engineer in Computer Vision

projects.name: Generative AI approaches to 3D
highlights: Leading YDrive’s efforts in creating systems capable of generating and understanding unbounded 3D scenes.
In charge of research and development of novel 3D generative models based on Gaussian Splatting.

projects.name: Structure from motion
highlights: Designed and maintained reliable and efficient state-of-the-art SFM solution for large scale reconstructions.
Delivered advancements in bundle adjustment through GPU efficient implementations and partitioning strategies. Reduced reconstruction time of thousands of images from days to hours.

Integrated deep learning into classical SFM for faster and more accurate reconstructions. \Adapted and extended academic works for pose estimation and camera calibration for production grade deployment.

projects.name: Neural rendering
highlights: Developed point cloud-based neural rendering system using neural network as rasterization model, achieving real-time 30FPS HD rendering with high visual fidelity.
Introduced spatio-temporal training regularization methods for mitigating flickering artifacts.
Led the productization of a highly optimized solution based on Unreal Engine plugin and WebRTC streaming integration for 5G enabled mobile devices.

projects.name: Internship management
highlights: Designed assignments and interviewed two generations of interns.
Defined research projects aligned with state of the art academic advancements and company road-map.
Supervised multiple internships with projects spanning from advanced techniques for point cloud rasterization to geometric regularization for Gaussian Splatting.

work.name: École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL)
work.position: Research Fellow, Visual Intelligence Lab (Prof. Amir Zamir)

projects.name: Representation learning on mid-level tasks in computer vision
highlights: Researched task balancing methods through loss weighting that led to stable training and comparable results across all tasks.
Designed dropout regularization methods to enforce hierarchy in latent representations through PCA-like properties. This enabled coarse-to-fine control of modalities directly at representation level.

projects.name: Structure From Motion
highlights: Optimized mapping pipeline for generating high-definition 3D maps reducing quadratic complexity to linear.
Researched and delivered point-free SFM solution using general 3D curves enabling reconstruction even on texture poor areas.

education.institution: University of Belgrade, Faculty of Electrical Engineering
education.thesis: Reducing complexity of bundle adjustment through partitioning methods

volunteer.summary: Mentorship to undergraduate and graduate students providing a strong foundational education in machine learning through lectures and practical work. Examples of practical projects include writing and training NeRF and image diffusion models from scratch.
Lecturer and mentor for motivated high school students in technical fields. The purpose of the camps is education in various fields, from applied physics to machine learning and control systems.

talks.name: Unreal Day - Epic Games
talks.title: Real-time Photorealistic Rendering of Unbounded Scenes
talks.summary: Presented YDrive’s neural rendering advancements to 400+ attendees.

projects.name: Sentence Completion using DSSM
projects.summary: Repurposed and trained Deep Structured Semantic Models for next word prediction. Done as a project during Practical Seminar in Machine Learning.

projects.name: Automatic Extractive Summarization of Multiple Documents
projects.summary: Reimplemented text ranking with recursive neural networks approach and its application to extractive summarization.

projects.name: Single Camera Plane Estimation and Tracking
projects.summary: Structure from motion pipeline from scratch in C++ simplified to planar scenes. Implemented core algorithms and structures for modeling multiple-view geometry.

projects.name: Application for Local Business Management
projects.summary: Developed a management application specialized for local business (Drvogalant Ltd.) in C# and maintained it since
